topic: Dragon said he would never forgive Sabo if the Cobra accusation were true, which shows the Army runs on a code
title: Dragon Would Never Forgive Sabo For This One Thing
description: Dragon's warning about Sabo and King Cobra in chapter 1058, and what it says about the rules the Revolutionary Army lives by.
comment: Is Dragon right to judge Sabo before hearing him out, or should the Army have trusted him instantly?

lines.text: Dragon told the world he'd never forgive Sabo, and he meant it.

shot.search: Dragon Revolutionary Army leader serious chapter 1058
shot.fallback: tattooed cloaked leader with a grim stare

lines.text: The news said Sabo had harmed King Cobra of Arabasta, and Dragon didn't wait for proof to say it.

shot.search: Nefertari Cobra assassination news Sabo framed
shot.fallback: newspaper headline about a king and a masked revolutionary

lines.text: That's chapter 1058. He said no reason would change it, even if Sabo was his own second in command.

shot.search: Dragon would not forgive Sabo Cobra Koala
shot.fallback: leader speaking firmly to a red haired aide

lines.text: Cobra was a fair king, and Dragon says attacking a ruler like that is not what the Army exists for.

shot.search: Nefertari Cobra fair king Arabasta Vivi father
shot.fallback: kind old king with a mustache smiling in a palace

lines.text: Chapter 1060 clears Sabo, and Dragon is relieved. But he also notes how little Sabo cares about the accusation.

shot.fallback: leader exhaling beside a bandaged man

lines.text: People say Dragon is just a warlord with a flag, willing to do anything. That's wrong, because he never calls for a Buster Call.

shot.search: Dragon World's Worst Criminal Revolutionary Army
shot.fallback: cloaked leader on a clifftop at night

lines.text: The Army has a code, and the first person it applies to is the man at the top of the line.

shot.search: Dragon Sabo Ivankov Momoiro Island meeting
shot.fallback: leader and two aides in a private hall

lines.text: And why a code like that lasts longer than any captain's crew is the bigger question.

shot.fallback: flag waving over a hidden island base

lines.text: Which is why Dragon told the world he'd never forgive Sabo

shot.search: Dragon tattoo green cloak close up
shot.fallback: leader's face with diamond tattoo, serious

self_check.hook: Contrarian claim naming Dragon and Sabo with chapter 1058
self_check.loop: last line hands directly into line 1's clause
